University of Bern and University Hospital Bern, Department of Diabetes, Endocrinology, Nutritional Medicine and Metabolism (UDEM)
Start of employment: By arrangement
Fixed term contract of 6 months (1 semester)
PrecisionLab, led by Prof. José García-Tirado, aims to develop new technology for managing diabetes and metabolic disorders through novel digital interventions such as advanced decision-support tools and automated insulin delivery. Aufgaben: You will work primarily on our web front-end project: a website for monitoring participants using our solutions during clinical trials. Monitoring is key for our research efforts and the website is our first line of defense for identifying and correcting anomalous situations with trial participants. As part of our software team you will: • Implement new features and improve the current monitoring website, including work on graphically plotting real-time participant data • Together with our researchers and medical professionals, work towards improving and implementing the UI/UX • Help with testing the website for future clinical trials Anforderungen: Important: This position is only for students currently enrolled in Swiss Universities (Master programs, PH matriculation). • Ongoing Masters in Computer Science or related fields Proficiency in: • JavaScript, TypeScript and Git • React or similar frontend libraries (such as Angular or Vue) Nive to have: • Experience with Kotlin (Spring Boot or Ktor) and SQL (PostgreSQL) • Experience with React applications • Experience consuming REST APIs and displaying vast amounts of data while accounting for performance • Experience with web deployments using Azure • Experience working with medical devices (continuous glucose monitors, insulin pumps, etc.) • Proficiency using graphical plot libraries such as ApexCharts or Visx • An eye for web UI/UX is a big plus Wir bieten: • We provide excellent scientific expertise in a dynamic environment and support a career focusing on translational research • A workplace in Bern, Switzerland's capital, known for its high quality of life and surrounded by beautiful nature, perfect for hiking, biking, swimming, and winter sports Equal employment opportunity: PrecisionLab at the University of Bern is an equal opportunity employer for women and individuals with disabilities and/or diverse backgrounds (race/ethnicity, sexual orientation, etc.). It actively seeks diversity among collaborators.

Università di Berna e Ospedale universitario Berna, Dipartimento di Diabete, Endometria, Medicina Nutrizionale e Metabolismo (UDEM) Inizio del lavoro: Con accordo Contratto a tempo determinato di 6 mesi (1 semestre) PrecisionLab, guidato dal Prof. José García-Tirado, mira a sviluppare nuove tecnologie per la gestione del diabete e dei disturbi metabolici attraverso nuovi interventi digitali come strumenti avanzati di supporto decisionale e la consegna automatica di insulina. Aufgaben: Lavorerai principalmente sul nostro progetto web front-end: un sito web per il monitoraggio dei partecipanti che utilizzano le nostre soluzioni durante gli studi clinici.

Il monitoraggio è fondamentale per i nostri sforzi di ricerca e il sito web è la nostra prima linea di difesa per identificare e correggere le situazioni di 591us con i partecipanti di prova.

Come parte del nostro team di software: • Implementa nuove funzionalità e migliora l'attuale sito web di monitoraggio, tra cui lavori su grafici che tracciano i dati dei partecipanti in tempo reale • Insieme ai nostri ricercatori e professionisti medici, lavora per migliorare e implementare il sito web di monitoraggio per i futuri studi clinici • Aiutare a testare il sito web per i futuri studi clinici Anfonderungen: Importante: Questa posizione è riservata solo agli studenti attualmente iscritti alle università svizzere (programmi Master, culminante PH).

• Master in Informatica o campi correlati Proficienza in: • JavaScript, TypeScript e Git • React or similar spider and spider (come Angolar or Vue) Nive to have: • Experience with Kotlin (Spring Boot or Ktor) and SQL (PostgreSQL) • Experience with React applications • Experience consumando API REST e visualizzando vaste quantità di dati mentre si contano per le prestazioni • Experience with web deployments using Azure • Experience working with medical devices (continuous glucosio monitors, insuline pompe, ecc.) • Proficiency using grafical libreries as ApexCharts or Visx

• Un occhio per il web UI/UX è un grande plus Wirbiet: • Offriamo un'eccellente esperienza scientifica in un ambiente dinamico e sosteniamo una carriera incentrata sulla ricerca traslazionale • Un lavoro a Berna, la capitale della Svizzera, conosciuta per la sua alta qualità di vita e circondata da una natura bellissima, perfetta per escursioni a piedi, in bicicletta, nuoto e sport invernali Pari opportunità di lavoro: PrecisionLab dell'Università di Berna è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità per le donne e le persone con disabilità e/o diversi background (razza/etnia, orientamento sessuale, ecc.).

Essa cerca attivamente la diversità tra i 1100rs.
descriptionByLocale.en:
University of Bern and University Hospital Bern, Department of Diabetes, Endocrinology, Nutritional Medicine and Metabolism (UDEM)
Start of employment: By arrangement
Fixed term contract of 6 months (1 semester)
PrecisionLab, led by Prof. José García-Tirado, aims to develop new technology for managing diabetes and metabolic disorders through novel digital interventions such as advanced decision-support tools and automated insulin delivery.

Aufgaben:
You will work primarily on our web front-end project: a website for monitoring participants using our solutions during clinical trials. Monitoring is key for our research efforts and the website is our first line of defense for identifying and correcting anomalous situations with trial participants.

As part of our software team you will:
• Implement new features and improve the current monitoring website, including work on graphically plotting real-time participant data

• Together with our researchers and medical professionals, work towards improving and implementing the UI/UX

• Help with testing the website for future clinical trials

Anforderungen:
Important: This position is only for students currently enrolled in Swiss Universities (Master programs, PH matriculation).

• Ongoing Masters in Computer Science or related fields

Proficiency in:
• JavaScript, TypeScript and Git

• React or similar frontend libraries (such as Angular or Vue)

Nive to have:
• Experience with Kotlin (Spring Boot or Ktor) and SQL (PostgreSQL)

• Experience with React applications

• Experience consuming REST APIs and displaying vast amounts of data while accounting for performance

• Experience with web deployments using Azure

• Experience working with medical devices (continuous glucose monitors, insulin pumps, etc.)

• Proficiency using graphical plot libraries such as ApexCharts or Visx

• An eye for web UI/UX is a big plus

Wir bieten:
• We provide excellent scientific expertise in a dynamic environment and support a career focusing on translational research

• A workplace in Bern, Switzerland's capital, known for its high quality of life and surrounded by beautiful nature, perfect for hiking, biking, swimming, and winter sports

Equal employment opportunity:
PrecisionLab at the University of Bern is an equal opportunity employer for women and individuals with disabilities and/or diverse backgrounds (race/ethnicity, sexual orientation, etc.). It actively seeks diversity among collaborators.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Université de Berne et hôpital universitaire Bern, Département de diabète, endocrinologie, médecine nutritionnelle et métabolisme (UDEM) Début de l'emploi : Par arrangement Contrat à durée déterminée de 6 mois (1 semestre) PrecisionLab, dirigé par le Prof. José García-Tirado, vise à développer de nouvelles technologies pour la gestion du diabète et des troubles métaboliques par de nouvelles interventions numériques telles que des outils avancés de soutien de la décision et l'administration automatisée de l'insuline.

Le suivi est essentiel pour nos efforts de recherche et le site Web est notre première ligne de défense pour identifier et corriger les situations anormales avec les participants aux essais.

Dans le cadre de notre équipe de logiciels, vous pourrez : • mettre en œuvre de nouvelles fonctionnalités et améliorer le site de monitoring actuel, y compris travailler sur la mise en page graphique des données des participants en temps réel • travailler avec nos chercheurs et professionnels de la santé pour améliorer et mettre en œuvre l'interface utilisateur/UX • aider à tester le site pour les essais cliniques futurs Anforderungen : Important : Ce poste n'est réservé qu'aux étudiants actuellement inscrits dans les universités suisses (maîtrise en PH).

• Maîtrise en informatique ou domaines connexes Compétence en : • JavaScript, TypeScript et Git • Réaction ou bibliothèques frontales similaires (comme Angular ou Vue) Nive à avoir : • Expérience avec Kotlin (Spring Boot ou Ktor) et SQL (PostgreSQL) • Expérience avec les applications de Réaction • Expérience de consommation d'API REST et d'affichage de grandes quantités de données tout en tenant compte des performances • Expérience avec les déploiements web utilisant Azure • Expérience de travail avec des dispositifs médicaux (moniteurs continus de glucose, pompes à insuline, etc.) • Compétence en utilisant des bibliothèques graphiques de tracés comme ApexCharts ou Visx

• Un œil pour le web UI/UX est un grand plus Wir bieten: • Nous fournissons une excellente expertise scientifique dans un environnement dynamique et soutenons une carrière axée sur la recherche translationnelle • Un lieu de travail à Berne, capitale de la Suisse, connue pour sa qualité de vie élevée et entourée de la nature belle, parfaite pour la randonnée, le vélo, la natation et les sports d'hiver.

Elle cherche activement la diversité parmi les collaborateurs.
